description: Ink Melt (2026-11-16; re-found by efsim rules --guided under the objective across starts, 2026-11-22). Laevatain's ultimate only while the enemy has Corrosion (Ardelia's; her Twilight attacks then shred resistance); Si's ultimate only while the enemy has Combustion and Laevatain is in Twilight (both on the Twilight attacks: the Twilight hold, kept); Wulfgard's ultimate when ready; Si's battle skill before Laevatain's and Ardelia's combos, Ardelia's before Wulfgard's; Laevatain's battle skill in Twilight and from 150 SP. Against the list before (the Twilight hold without Combustion, Laevatain's ultimate when ready), 64 fresh seeds (1001–1064, 300 s, 0.3 s reaction), the objective across starts (the mean of full energy and from zero per seed): +3.21% ± 0.73 (full energy +7.47% ± 1.10, 59,623 → 64,075; from zero −1.08% ± 0.80, 59,127 → 58,487).
